strings.name: Amina J. Mohammed
strings.summary: Mohammed moved from construction-project management into development policy, coordinating Nigeria’s Millennium Development Goals, debt-relief resources and public programmes. She served as a UN development-planning adviser and Nigeria’s environment minister before becoming UN deputy secretary-general in 2017. She also chairs the Sustainable Development Group, connecting development policy, climate action and gender equality.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Development-goal coordination
strings.highlights.h1.text: Contributed to intergovernmental coordination of the post-2015 agenda and Sustainable Development Goals.
strings.highlights.h2.title: UN development system
strings.highlights.h2.text: Coordinates inter-agency development work as deputy secretary-general and Sustainable Development Group chair.

strings.timeline.t3.title: Became environment minister
strings.timeline.t3.text: Served as Nigeria’s environment minister until February 2017.

strings.timeline.t4.text: Worked on the post-2015 agenda as the UN adopted the Sustainable Development Goals.

strings.timeline.t5.text: Advised Ban Ki-moon on post-2015 development planning.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Coordinated development resources
strings.timeline.t6.text: Worked to direct Nigeria’s debt-relief resources toward Millennium Development Goals.

strings.timeline.t7.text: Founded Afri-Projects Consortium and led its project work.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered construction projects
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began work in Nigerian architectural and project services.
